subject.title: fix #91171: [Bug]: Sub-agent model routing ignores model parameter, silently falls back to deepseek

question: Should explicit `sessions_spawn.model` launches use `operator.admin` for the out-of-process Gateway call and internal `allowModelOverride` for in-process dispatch, as implemented here?
rationale: The patch is technically consistent with the existing Gateway override checks, but accepting admin-equivalent authority for this internal launch path is an authorization-boundary choice that should be owned explicitly rather than inferred from passing tests.

options.title: Accept the bounded existing mechanisms
options.body: Approve admin scope only for out-of-process launches carrying an explicit override and the internal flag only for equivalent in-process launches.

options.title: Require a narrower override capability
options.body: Hold the PR and introduce a dedicated internal model-routing capability so the child launch does not rely on general `operator.admin` authority.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded existing mechanisms
recommendation.body: Approve admin scope only for out-of-process launches carrying an explicit override and the internal flag only for equivalent in-process launches.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across sub-agent control boundaries and adjacent provider/model routing code.
